tables.description: معیارهای شواهد برای استخراج هر ماژول

executable_decisions.decision: A01 target already approved; historical extractable modular monolith is comparison only; module independence now, deployment cost only on evidence
Schematic grouping does not approve ownership or deployment; isolated Computer Use may be justified but requires testing
Architecture comparisons are qualitative/conditional; migration cost depends on workload, teams, security, and design
Logical data ownership; ban direct private-table access; public versioned contracts; Core/Adviser/Assistant API ownership; breaking changes need version/migration; acyclic dependencies enforced in CI
Assistant workflow/backend/Computer Use responsibilities separated; Adviser reasoning grants no banking authority
Events are contract-based and emitted through transactional outbox when reliable publication needed; idempotent consumers; Job Queue differs from Event Bus; broker/2PC not prerequisite
PostgreSQL owns durable job state initially; adapters separate engine choice; old jobs complete in old engine during gradual migration; no claim of code-free Temporal migration
Measure observability, cost, baselines and dependencies before extraction; telemetry tools/options require security/cost/capacity review
Gradual Strangler Fig migration has no approved order or schedule; extract only with evidence and cost-benefit, user count alone insufficient
Phase-one VM baseline is not phase-two capacity; benchmark equal workloads before claims
Architecture tests remain proposed; contract/financial interpretation failure and security/config/data leak failures are blocking gates; no new tool or VM mandated absent sizing and approval
Hybrid option is conditional only; deployment architecture remains unselected and this section grants no implementation task/code change

Chapter five policy states O5-01..14 and three-stage policy approved; timing, budget, rollout, tasks and code/deployment authorization require independent evidence/approval; no task/PR/date is created by historic V0.8 note
Approved policy distinguishes phase, stage, release increment, user story/task; pursue full stage capability scope with smaller releases; avoid silent omission and PoC-only value

B05 domain/data boundaries, purposeful authorization for cross-domain transfer; technology reuse does not establish readiness; no operational bank API requirement for Assistant; A01 remains baseline and owner decision required for change; no invented task or design change without approval
